//: Distress beacon system.  Every beacon is called 'distress beacon' and looks exactly the same; each has its own item id and its own outcome.  Good: Jedi, Mandalorian, Devil Hunter, Adventuring Party.  Bad: Abductor gang, Contract Killer, Predator Demon, Sith.  50/50: Mandalorian Outcast (ally beacon + foe beacon, each half as common as the others).
//2: Old ids kept so existing saves stay valid: jedi_distress_beacon (Jedi, jedi/jedi_ally.json), mando_tracking_fob (Mandalorian, npcstuff/mando_bounty_hunter.json), mando_outcast_fob (outcast ally, npcstuff/mando_outcast.json).
//3: Nine equal outcomes: eight at prob 100, the outcast split into two beacons at prob 50 each.  The party is four beacons in one drop.

description: A cracked, palm-sized comms beacon that still hums faintly.  Activating it broadcasts a distress signal on every frequency, and something out there will answer.  There is no telling what.

use_action.summon_msg: The beacon squeals, then goes quiet.  Somewhere behind you a motorcycle engine cuts out and a voice drawls, "Somebody order a devil hunter?"
The beacon squeals.  Armor clanks in the distance, and a heavily armored fighter strides out of the gloom.
The beacon squeals.  The air crackles, and a robed mage steps out of a shimmer of light.
The beacon squeals.  Something moves in the shadows, and a hooded thief slips into view as if they had been there all along.
The beacon squeals.  An arrow thuds into the ground at your feet, and an archer lowers their bow with a grin.
The beacon squeals, then wails.  A red blade hisses to life in the dark, and a cold voice says, "Your call has been answered."
The beacon crackles.  Someone in scavenged beskar steps out of cover, blaster already raised.  They were not looking for a rescue.

use_action.friendly_msg: A contract killer steps out of the dark.  They look at you, then at the beacon, and nod.
use_action.hostile_msg: The beacon crackles with a burst of static.  A contract killer steps out of the dark: this signal was the last thing they needed to find you.

use_action.friendly_msg: Something huge answers the call, and for a moment it hesitates.
use_action.hostile_msg: The beacon shrieks.  The shadows peel away and a predator demon unfolds beside you, drawn by the signal.

description: A distress beacon's answer: a gang of abductor demons arrives on top of the signal.
message: The beacon shrieks, and abductor demons tear their way into the world around you!
